gap_classification.notes: Credit Agricole CIB's GIFT City IFSC Banking Unit (opened Aug 2025) page (ca-cib.com/en/our-ifsc-banking-unit-gift-city-india) lists only wholesale/corporate cross-border products: External Commercial Borrowings, buyer/supplier credit, letters of credit, bank guarantees, receivable & supply-chain finance. No term/fixed-deposit product and no deposit interest-rate card published.
